sources.ref: CONVEYOR SYSTEM PROBLEMS/CAUSES AND THEIR SOLUTIONS
CONVEYOR SYSTEM PROBLEMS/CAUSES AND THEIR SOLUTIONS

actions: re-splice using proper method as recommended by Fenner Dunlop.
increase speed, same tonnage, same speed
reduce friction with better maintenance and replacement of damaged idlers
decrease tension by increasing arc of contact or go to lagged pulley

causes.cause: Material trapped between belt and pulley
actions: install plows or scrapers on return run ahead of tail pulley.

causes.cause: Improper transition between troughed belt and terminal pulleys
actions: adjust transition in accordance with CEMA standards and Fenner Dunlop Belting Catalogs.
